newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent market closed Friday and Monday.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent market closed Friday and Monday.

text.p: The Brent crude market on the Singapore International Monetary Exchange (SIMEX) will be closed on Friday and Monday, SIMEX officials said on Tuesday.
The closure will mark the corresponding closure on Friday and Monday of the Brent market on the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) in London.
SIMEX Brent operates a mutual offset system with the IPE in London, so SIMEX tends to close in line with the U.K..
